reviews.comment:
Pésimo el servicio de la tarde, llegue a cargar el celular para poder comprar algo para merendar, y la red wifi no anda, enzima me dice que me tengo que ir si no consumo, le dije que estaba esperando la red wifi que se conecte y me habló pésimo.. no pensé que eran así acá en San Luis tan egoísta la señora de la tarde, se piensa que por qué uno es de afuera los tienen que tratar mal

(Translated by Google)
The afternoon service was terrible. I went to charge my phone so I could buy a snack, and the Wi-Fi wasn't working. On top of that, she told me I had to leave if I wasn't going to buy anything. I told her I was waiting for the Wi-Fi to connect, and she spoke to me rudely. I didn't think people were like that here in San Luis. The woman who worked the afternoon shift was so selfish; she thinks that just because you're from out of town, you have to be treated badly.

reviewReply.comment:
Hola Noelia. Lamentamos mucho leer sobre tu experiencia y te pedimos disculpas sinceramente por el trato recibido. 
La atención con respeto y hospitalidad es prioritaria para nosotros.
Para poder revisar lo sucedido con el personal del turno tarde y solucionar el inconveniente técnico con la red Wi-Fi, podrías enviarnos un correo a antofasrl@gmail.com brindándonos mayor información.
Desde ya agradecemos tu visita.
